title: decode.rs base64 preview pre-truncation to multiple-of-4 is correct — prevents spurious decode errors
description: decode_body_value() computes max_b64_chars = max_bytes.saturating_mul(4).div_ceil(3).next_multiple_of(4) before stripping CRLF from the base64 input. A contributor might suggest simplifying this calculation. The next_multiple_of(4) rounding is load-bearing: the STANDARD (padded) base64 engine rejects inputs whose length is not a multiple of 4, so a naive truncation would cause spurious decode errors. The rounding ensures the truncated input is always a complete base64 group. Tests test_base64_max_bytes_non_multiple_of_4 and test_base64_is_truncated_multiple_of_3 verify this.
